question: Under fixed stimuli and matched resource budgets, does e-graph feedback improve generated monitor correctness, effective fault detection and cost efficiency?
scope: Audit completed v1 evidence and calibrate a property-slot formal harness; not a new B/C effectiveness trial

calibration.selection: First final candidate sorted by arm then repetition; chosen before slot outcomes, without using fault scores
calibration.change: Replace the vector assertion by one selected slot implication and retain only that slot's active cover; all DUT parameters, sampling and assumptions unchanged
calibration.stop_policy: Stop candidate jobs if plumbing controls fail; no retries, solver changes, extra slots or budget increases after outcomes

interpretation.bmc_pass: No counterexample within the requested bounded check, not an unbounded proof or independent specification truth
interpretation.fail: Candidate/DUT assertion counterexample requiring independent reference adjudication; no automatic DUT-bug label
interpretation.incomplete: TIMEOUT, UNKNOWN, ERROR and missing jobs remain incomplete
interpretation.comparison: Historical vector TIMEOUT and new split results are infrastructure calibration, not a randomized solver comparison or fresh B/C replication
interpretation.source_integrity: Verify v1 membership before and after; never edit old source, reference, freeze or results

next_live_trial_requirements.registration: Separate registration and live freeze required; this file cannot authorize generation
next_live_trial_requirements.roles: Claude authors/revises the independent specification checker; GPT candidates remain evaluated artifacts; GPT/Codex builds infrastructure
next_live_trial_requirements.task_gate: Select one more discriminating monitor task from a predeclared shortlist using specification clarity, semantic relevance and formal tractability, before new B/C outcomes
next_live_trial_requirements.fixed_inputs: Freeze identical development observations and fresh hidden final faults/traces for all arms; v1 final cases are calibration only
next_live_trial_requirements.candidate_release: Freeze every round's candidate snapshot before hidden scoring; final selection by declared round/validity order only; never return hidden feedback
next_live_trial_requirements.budget: Declare equal model, reasoning, repetitions, rounds, token caps, compile/replay and total formal caps across arms before calls; count actual tokens separately
next_live_trial_requirements.endpoints: Fixed-budget correct-control validity, distinct observable fault recall and eligible-pair detection, each gated by independent truth; cost and unresolved rates retained
next_live_trial_requirements.semantic_control: Map certified guards to task-relevant source points and conditions; ordinary raw hits are not monitor quality. Without token-matched placebo, claim only the whole feedback-package effect
next_live_trial_requirements.stop: No live calls until task/specification/reference review, legal controls, observability, semantic mapping, prompt isolation, accounting and candidate-release gates are frozen
